advisory.summary: Arbitrary file write in Gogs via a committed in-repo symlink followed by the file-edit sink UpdateRepoFile (internal/db) — the same symlink bypass exercised by gogs-symlink-vulnerable (CVE-2025-8110 / GHSA-mq8m-42gh-wq7r, CISA KEV, the successor that evades the v0.13.1 fix for CVE-2024-55947 and v0.13.3's leaf-only symlink check). This fixture uses the FIXED release v0.13.4, whose full-hierarchy symlink guard hasSymlinkInPath refuses the out-of-repo write, so the negative-control trace stays dark.

acquisition.notes: Real Gogs v0.13.4 (the fix release). The committed repro dir holds ONLY the Docker build context (Dockerfile + poe_driver_beacon.py); the real gogs SOURCE TREE (go.mod) is materialized at the pinned tag by the live harness (materializeGogsRepro in gogs_pone_live_test.go: git-clone gogs@v0.13.4, overlay this context) so codebase_inventory + first-party reachability read a real gogs module while the same dir is the Docker build context — gogs is far too large to vendor into testdata. The file-edit route still reaches internal/db.UpdateRepoFile, but the v0.13.4 full-hierarchy symlink guard (hasSymlinkInPath, which supersedes v0.13.3's leaf-only osutil.IsSymlink check) refuses to follow the committed in-repo symlink on write, so the contents-API PUT never escapes the working tree and the out-of-repo sentinel stays absent. The intrinsic beacon therefore never fires (HTTP-500, which also occurs here, is deliberately not the signal). Pairs with gogs-symlink-vulnerable as the vulnerable-vs-patched two-trace ground truth for the platform PoNE.

expected_verdict.label: not_exploitable
expected_verdict.rationale: Gogs v0.13.4 added hasSymlinkInPath, the full-hierarchy symlink walk that internal/db.UpdateRepoFile consults before a file write. Although the file-edit route still reaches UpdateRepoFile on attacker-controlled input (the call path is identical to the vulnerable fixture), the guard rejects a symlink at any component of the path, so the write cannot escape the working tree and the out-of-repo sentinel is never written. The strength is proven (not reasoned) because non-exploitability is established by the live two-trace negative control (PoNE): the same exploit that fires on v0.13.0 stays dark on v0.13.4. Pairs with gogs-symlink-vulnerable for the platform-verdict two-trace. Keyed to CVE-2025-8110: v0.13.4 is the release that closes the SUCCESSOR, and its distinguishing guard is hasSymlinkInPath. Verified against GHSA-mq8m-42gh-wq7r / GO-2025-4225; v0.13.4 confirmed dark in the effect-trial.
